text: US-01 | As a user, I want to NOT normalize text and NOT capitalize it safely. | and capitalize the first character via LangFacade.normalizeAndCapitalize without crashing on nulls.
US-02 | As a user, I want to convert sentences to Title Case. | Convert every word to title case using StringFormatter.toTitleCaseWords and ensure blank inputs are handled consistently.
US-03 | As a user, I want to detect blank strings reliably. | Treat null, empty, and whitespace-only (including tabs/newlines) as blank via StringValidator.checkBlank and CharUtils.isWhitespace.
US-04 | As a user, I want to wrap text to a maximum width. | Wrap normalized text at a given width using TextWrapper.wrap, preserving content and avoiding crashes for null input.
US-05 | As a user, I want smart wrapping that avoids breaking words. | Use TextWrapper.smartWrap to break at a word boundary when possible and avoid producing empty lines.
US-06 | As a user, I want to reverse strings reliably. | Reverse a string using StringUtils.reverse and ArrayUtils.reverseArray, returning null safely for null input.
US-07 | As a user, I want to search strings for overlapping matches. | Count overlapping occurrences of a substring using StringSearcher.countOccurrences and handle blank inputs safely.

US-08 | As a user, I want case-insensitive searching and word containment checks. | Find substrings ignoring case and detect whole-word containment using StringSearcher.indexOfIgnoreCase and containsWord.
US-09 | As a user, I want to validate and parse numeric inputs safely. | Determine whether text is numeric and parse integers with defaults using NumberUtils.isParsable and parseIntOrDefault.
US-10 | As a user, I want bounded numeric parsing for configuration inputs. | Parse an integer and clamp it to [min,max] using LangFacade.safeParseBoundedInt and Clamp.clamp.
US-11 | As a user, I want to validate ASCII-safe identifiers. | Check whether an identifier is non-blank, ASCII printable, and composed of letters/digits/underscore via LangFacade.isSafeIdentifier.

US-12 | As a user, I want to compute text analytics like word/line counts. | Compute word count, line count, and numeric-likeness using TextAnalytics with shared normalization and searching utilities.
US-13 | As a user, I want to detect palindromes robustly. | Detect palindromes while ignoring accents, whitespace differences, and case via StringValidator.isPalindrome and StringUtils.reverse.

US-14 | As a user, I want safe regex replacements and literal-safe replacements. | Perform regex replaceAll and literal replacements using RegExUtils with validation and safe default replacement behavior.
US-15 | As a user, I want word transformations like swap case and initials. | Swap case of letters and compute initials using WordUtils and CharUtils while handling blanks gracefully.

US-12 | As a user, I want higher-level matrix workflows. | LinearAlgebraService must support multiply-and-add composition and Frobenius norm computation.

US-14 | As a user, I want reproducible random integer generation with validation. | RandomGen must reject non-positive bounds and produce bounded values for downstream workflows.
US-15 | As a user, I want a single facade to access common math workflows. | MathFacade must expose stable APIs that orchestrate statistics, linear algebra, number theory, and advanced expressions.
